text: Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values (type, relation, value, units) for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613797. Select canonical_smiles, molecule chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Source from assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Join assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter where assays.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1613797'. Do not deduplicate.
